test_cases.tc_title: When requested via this DID, the radio shall report the Visible Satellites as provided by the internal GPS receiver. ($2812, NRC 13 incorrectMessageLengthOrInvalidFormat)

2. The diagnostic tool is connected to the OBD-II diagnostic connector
test_cases.test_procedure:

   $ 22 28 12
